summary: PMGC Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary NorthStrive Biosciences entered into a First Amendment to its existing Development and License Agreement with Yuva Biosciences. The amendment formalizes a three-phase AI-driven expansion program for four compounds and updates terms around IP, field of use, and financials. This is a routine contract modification, not a special-situation corporate event. The filing also notes standard amendments to articles/bylaws and Regulation FD disclosure, but no transaction, board change, or restructuring is indicated. No deal terms, prices, or strategic review are present. Watch for material updates from the license program only if disclosed separately.
